sources.title: w2v-bert-2.0: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview w2v-bert-2.0 is a 600M-parameter Conformer-based speech encoder developed by facebook and released as part of the Seamless Communication project. The model was pre-trained on 4.5M hours of unlabeled audio data across more than 143 languages, making it one of the most multilingual speech representation models available.
